evidence.claim: Profile fit: product H, purchaser email aol.com and the amount $34.22 all match card C02753-K1 before the last 7 days (6 earlier H purchases, 5 with this email, largest earlier purchase $3,162.97)

Card C02753-K1 already has 2 confirmed-fraud closed case(s) (CC-1739, CC-4010). The account key is not usable in January, so the precedent is read at card level, where it is weaker: on cards of this size an earlier confirmed case made a new alert about 3.9 times as likely to be fraud
The anonymous proxy on this purchase is not new: purchases on card C02753-K1 more than 7 days earlier came through one too
Profile fit: the purchase hour (15:00) is one the account already uses (23% of its earlier purchases within an hour of it)
The alert states a model score of 0.80, but transaction 3612011 carries 0.03 in the bank's records; the recorded value is used and the stated one is treated as unverified alert text
Policy applied, Fraud Policy R3: Customer confirms the transaction: Recommend CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.

Graph and vector fused: closed case CC-0269 (cleared, none) is reached through the device profile Windows | Windows 7 | chrome generic | 1680x1050, which card C08256-K2 also used in the 30 days to the alert, and its analyst note is the closest to this case among the connected closed cases (similarity 0.79)

case.summary: Alert HHF-018 opened because the bank's model flagged transaction 3612011 (recorded score 0.03) ($34.22, product H, online, 2017-01-01 15:29) on card C02753-K1. The evidence points to the cardholder: Profile fit: product H, purchaser email aol.com and the amount $34.22 all match card C02753-K1 before the last 7 days; The anonymous proxy on this purchase is not new: purchases on card C02753-K1 more than 7 days earlier came through one too. Fraud probability 0.27; the alert is closed as legitimate (allow transaction, verify with customer, monitor card, close no fraud). Evidence request: No reply from the customer within 24 hours.
